description:
Stunning, Modern Fully Furnished 2-Bed Apartments to Rent in Swords

Discover contemporary living at Occu Cedar Place, a premium rental development ideally located in an established residential suburb between Swords and Dublin. Enjoy the perfect balance of excellent local amenities, convenient transport links, and beautifully maintained green surroundings.

Our spacious 2-bedroom apartments, as well as 2-bedroom apartments with a study, are thoughtfully designed for modern living. Each home features open-plan living and dining areas, high-quality finishes throughout, and a large private balcony overlooking professionally landscaped gardens.

Apartment Features
Fully furnished to a high standard
Spacious open-plan layouts
Large private balcony
High-quality finishes throughout
Secure car parking
Security alarm installed
Professionally landscaped communal gardens
BER ratings between A2 and A3

At Occu, we believe renting should be better. That's why we provide a smarter, more resident-focused rental experience with:

Pet-friendly homes
No hidden costs
Professionally managed properties
Quality homes designed with comfort and convenience in mind

Occu. Better renting. That's different.

Please note: Photographs are for illustrative purposes and may not represent the exact apartment available. However, all apartments are finished to a similar high standard.
